# elk-components strict usage contract

Package: `elk-components`
Purpose: React 18+ class-controller-backed UI, layout, animation, style, and icon primitives.
Repository documentation: ./docs/AI_COMPONENT_RULES.md
General API reference: ./README.md
Contributor architecture: ./AIAgent.md

## Public entrypoints

- `elk-components`: components, class reactor, stores, hooks, and EStyle
- `elk-components/hooks`: hook and store APIs
- `elk-components/icons`: individual icon components
- `elk-components/style-rule`: EStyle CSS-in-JS engine
- `elk-components/plugin`: Vite auto-import plugin
- `elk-components/styles.css`: packaged component CSS

## Highest priority rules

1. Content slots use `React.JSX.ElementType`. Pass `child={() => <Text ... />}`.
   Never pass `child={<Text ... />}` and do not use conventional nested children
   unless that component explicitly documents support.
2. Named slots such as `header`, `body`, `footer`, `title`, `leading`, `trailing`,
   and `action` also receive zero-argument component functions.
3. Native events and attributes belong in `gest`, for example
   `gest={{ onClick, "aria-label": "Save" }}`.
4. Use top-level `className` and `style`; do not hide those in `gest`.
5. Declare owned structure through component props: `padding`, `width`, `height`,
   `gap`, `direction`, `align`, and `justify`.
6. Use EStyle classes for pseudo states, descendant selectors, attributes, and
   media rules. Call `.mount("stable-namespace")` once at module scope when using
   `styles.classes.*`. Mount is not needed for inline-only `styles.rule.*()`.
7. `Components<State>` is a plain TypeScript reactor controller, not
   `React.Component`. Never call React hooks inside it.
8. Use `useComponent(() => new Controller())` to create and subscribe to one
   controller per wrapper instance.
9. State updates must return a new snapshot:
   `this.set(state => ({ ...state, count: state.count + 1 }))`.
10. Never import internal underscore classes, instantiate them in application
    code, or call their `build()` methods.
11. Use `onFunc` only for documented imperative controls, not normal rendering
    or state flow.
12. Every icon-only button requires an accessible name.
13. Prefer semantic Button/anchor behavior over clickable layout containers.
14. Import `elk-components/styles.css` once when packaged CSS components are used.
15. Do not mix controlled props with competing uncontrolled defaults.

## Correct minimal example

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Container,
  Icon,
  Stack,
  Text,
} from "elk-components";
import { ArrowRight } from "elk-components/icons";
import "elk-components/styles.css";

export function WelcomeCard() {
  return (
    <Container
      width="100%"
      padding="1.5rem"
      gest={{ role: "region", "aria-label": "Welcome" }}
      child={() => (
        <Stack
          gap="1rem"
          child={() => (
            <>
              <Text type="h2" text="Welcome" />
              <Text type="p" text="Continue setting up your workspace." />
              <Button
                padding=".75rem 1rem"
                gest={{ onClick: continueSetup }}
                child={() => (
                  <Stack
                    direction="row"
                    align="center"
                    gap=".5rem"
                    child={() => (
                      <>
                        <Text type="p" text="Continue" />
                        <Icon icon={ArrowRight} size="sm" />
                      </>
                    )}
                  />
                )}
              />
            </>
          )}
        />
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

## Correct reactor example

```tsx
class CounterController extends Components<{ count: number }> {
  constructor() {
    super({ count: 0 });
  }

  increment = () =>
    this.set(state => ({ ...state, count: state.count + 1 }));
}

function Counter() {
  const [controller, state] = useComponent(() => new CounterController());
  return (
    <Button
      gest={{ onClick: controller.increment }}
      child={() => <Text type="p" text={`Count: ${state.count}`} />}
    />
  );
}
```

## Correct EStyle example

```tsx
const styles = new Estyle()
  .defineRules({
    action: {
      color: "white",
      backgroundColor: "#173f36",
      "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#d75632" },
      "&:focus-visible": { outline: "3px solid #4668df" },
    },
  })
  .defineMedia({
    "(max-width: 600px)": { action: { width: "100%" } },
  })
  .mount("account-action");

<Button
  className={styles.classes.action}
  padding=".75rem 1rem"
  child={() => <Text type="p" text="Save" />}
/>;
```

## Forbidden patterns

- raw JSX in ElementType slots
- conventional children on slot-based components
- hooks inside controller classes
- direct imports from `src/lib/components`
- manually calling controller `build()`
- module-global stores for local rerender state
- unlabelled icon buttons
- unsupported top-level native event props
- generated class usage without mounting the EStyle sheet
- mounting a new EStyle sheet during every render

Read `docs/AI_COMPONENT_RULES.md` before generating non-trivial code.
